name: Wish on this Flower
source:
A curious fairy chooses a simple dandelion – an ordinary weed, or something more? Together, they discover what it means to be special, imperfect, and loved.

[From [url=https://ministarfruit.itch.io/wish-on-this-flower]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位好奇的仙女选择了一朵简单的蒲公英——一种普通的杂草，还是其他什么？他们一起发现了特殊、不完美和被爱意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://ministarfruit.itch.io/wish-on-this-flower]Itch.io[/url]]
